dogecoin.text: Latvian airline @airBaltic expands cryptocurrency payment options. Airline passengers can pay with two more cryptocurrencies - $Doge and $ETH. Before that, the airBaltic‘s cryptocurrency payment system had $BCH, $USDC, $BUSD, $GUSD and $PAX.

Believe it or not, @SpaceX will really send @dogecoin to the moon! @elonmusk's company along with their Canadian partner will be the 1st to take $DOGE as payment to launch a satellite as part of the #DOGE-1 lunar mission.
